items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine Interview, 1957-03-26
items.q: I played in the morning for Dr. Cabdor when he was on Ramport and Legion Field in the morning, on a Mardi Gras morning.

ctx.x: The End The End I'm going to have to run along. You all keep going.

Yes, several times he came here. He came here a few times, see. So, music was a wonderful thing one time ago. Oh, boy, day and night I'd be going. Now, there's a coincidence. If you were to tell a man he played five tours, five jobs, five engagements in one day, he'd laugh at you. He'd laugh at you. I was myself. Now, I played in the morning for Dr. Cabdor when he was on Ramport and Legion Field in the morning, on a Mardi Gras morning. I played in advertising for him for antiseptic tablets. All the boys were in a…
Five, five jobs. I have to run along to get out to the Met maybe. Three thirty. Thank you very much and I'll see you all later. All right.
